name: Death End Re;Quest 3
summary: Death end re;Quest 3 will be a true continuation of the Death end re;Quest series, will introduce features like ''catching your own bugs'', ''debugging'' and ''a feature that predicts a Death End'. Like Death end re;Quest: Code Z, Death end re;Quest 3 will also aim to be rated CERO-Z to aim for something more extreme and intense, and will focus on adding replay value to this entry by including new features and systems that should feel fresh even for players of the previous titles.
